text: Nagasunehiko still refused to give in, because he served Nigihayahi, another descendant of the gods.
spoken: Nahgahsoonehheeko still refused to give in, because he served Neegeehahyahhee, another descendant of the gods.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, po nazwie, długie słowo (5 syl.)
